_comment: General interest charge rates (TAA 1953 s 8AAD), used for the notional earnings component (SGAA s 19A). The ATO publishes these quarterly; the daily rate is the annual rate divided by the number of days in the calendar year. Update each quarter from the ATO 'General interest charge rates' page, and record where the figure actually came from.

quarters.source: Australian Taxation Office, General interest charge (GIC) rates; official 2025-26 quarterly table, last updated 5 June 2026.
